evaluation_protocol.length_observation_rule: generate maximum capture length once; every shorter observed and clean row is a bit-exact cf32le prefix of the corresponding maximum-length row

novelty.calibration: none; frozen per-length stage-1 noise-prefilter bundles, the frozen stage-2 branch-LOF ensemble and geometry blend, and the frozen composite survivor policy (enrollment-survivor stage-1 rank calibration and its q97 composite threshold) are loaded verbatim
novelty.generation: generate each fresh openset_eval.NOVELTY realization once at maximum capture length; shorter observations are exact prefixes; one family seed derived by SHA-256 from base seed and family
novelty.seed_derivation: uint64 little-endian first 8 bytes of SHA-256(utf8(base seed decimal + NUL + family))
novelty.seed_rule: the novelty base seed equals the untouched release seed; consumed release seeds and development novelty/fitting seed bands are refused

open_set.classifier_role: the regularized 8k fusion supplies every accepted known-class label and every closed/five-shot/clean/length/scale gate input
decision_order: 4k rejector fusion and frozen staged known/unknown policy
8k classifier fusion nearest-prototype known label for accepted rows
open_set.known_false_unknown_accounting: counts both stages: a known row gated by the stage-1 noise prefilter and a known survivor whose COMPOSITE score exceeds the frozen staged threshold (q97 of the composite over enrollment survivors) are both false-unknown, and every per-length open report attributes each rejected known row to the stage that rejected it. The additive control arm uses the stage-2 policy's own untouched threshold

policy_hygiene.only_policy_change: composite survivor enrollment threshold quantile q99 -> q97
policy_hygiene.threshold_population: enrollment stage-1 survivors only (enrollment only, as every rank and threshold in this chain)

open_set.rejector_role: the frozen 4k fusion supplies every stage-2 known/unknown score and every open-set gate input; it never supplies the final accepted known-class label
open_set.score_axis: Stage-2 scores are enrollment empirical ranks in [0, 1).  A stage-1 survivor's staged score is the COMPOSITE max(stage2_enrollment_rank, stage1_score_enrollment_rank), also in [0, 1), where the stage-1 rank is the empirical enrollment rank of the stage-1 log-odds fit on ENROLLMENT stage-1 survivors only (searchsorted-left, the stage-2 convention).  A row gated at stage 1 has no stage-2 score at all -- that is the short circuit -- and is placed at 1.0 + a bounded monotone map (softsign) of its stage-1 log-odds, i.e. in (1, 2), above every survivor.  The staged unknown threshold is the frozen q0.97 of the composite over enrollment survivors, so the staged score is a single axis on which 'score > staged threshold' is exactly the staged decision 'gated at stage 1, or composite-rejected at stage 2', which is asserted row by row.  AUROC and threshold recall computed from it are properties of the staged system, not of either stage read in isolation.

stage_one_prefix_rule.rule: at a capture length ABOVE the longest fitted prefilter length, the stage-1 pose-degeneracy features are computed on the capture's FIRST max-fitted-length samples and gated with that length's bundle.  The first N samples of a longer capture are exactly an N-sample capture of the same emission, so this is the same causal-prefix rule the release protocol's length suite is built on, not an approximation.  Lengths BELOW the smallest fitted length keep the existing refusal semantics: no fitted length is a causal prefix of such a capture, so no bundle may be substituted

open_set.stage_one_uncovered_rule: at a capture length ABOVE the longest fitted stage-1 length the gate applies through the causal-prefix rule (stage_one_prefix_rule): features are computed on the capture's first max-fitted-length samples and gated with that length's bundle, recorded as stage_one_active: true with the effective stage_one_feature_length; at a capture length BELOW the smallest fitted length the gate cannot fire and every row flows to the unchanged additive stage-2 path, recorded as stage_one_active: false
open_set.sweep_rejector_rule: the causal-length and physical-scale sweeps measure the closed-set representation exactly as the v2 evaluator defined them; no stage gates their rows (rejection never participates in the closed and invariance gates, and the stage-1 causal-prefix rule does not change that)
open_set.unknown_threshold_rule: the staged unknown threshold is the frozen q0.97 of the composite over enrollment stage-1 survivors, fit on enrollment only and loaded verbatim from the staged artifact; the additive control arm keeps the stage-2 policy's own untouched enrollment threshold

physical_scale_support.rule: for every requested factor, effective resampling scale times (abs(centreOffsetFrac) + bandwidthHz/(2*sampleRateHz)) must be strictly below 0.5 - edge_guard_fraction
physical_scale_support.selection_timing: metadata-only common subset fixed before preprocessing or inference

start_probe.purpose: select one occupied start per row before longest-only nuisance realization
